title: RELATEDTABLE reaches the fact table across a chain of relationships
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Category, "Category", Category[Category], "Sales Rows", COUNTROWS ( RELATEDTABLE ( Sales ) ), "Products", COUNTROWS ( RELATEDTABLE ( Product ) ) )

source.quote: The result is the number of rows in Sales that are related to each category
source.supports: the article counts the Sales rows of each Category across Product and Subcategory

source.quote: it returns the products that belong to the current category
source.supports: RELATEDTABLE ( Product ) in a row context on Category returns the category's products

derivation: Bikes: subcategories 10, 11; products 100, 101, 102 (3); Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 4 (4). Parts: subcategories 20, 21; products 103, 104 (2); Sales rows 5, 6 (2). Clothing: no subcategory, so no products and no sales: both BLANK.
